test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 25 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The selling price of 28 items is equal to the cost price of 16 items. What is the profit or loss percent? (correct to 2 decimal places)
solution:
Given:

The selling price of 28 items is equal to the cost price of 16 items.

Concept used:

Selling price = Cost price - Loss

Calculation:

Let cost price of each item be Rs. 1

So, cost price of 28 items = Rs. 28

Selling price of 28 items = Rs. 16

Loss = 28 - 16

⇒ Rs. 12

Loss % = (12/28) × 100

⇒ 42.86 %

∴ The loss percentage is 42.86 %.
